description: Approve a draft spec so agents can work on its tasks. Medium and high risk need human:*; low risk also allows agent:architect. Moves linked backlog tasks with no open blockers to ready and writes specs/SPEC-<n>.md into the repo (a human commits it).

on_behalf_of.description: When a human explicitly asked you (an agent) to do this: their id, e.g. human:umit. You cannot approve a spec you authored

name: approve_spec
title: Approve Spec
